name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic Rotating Standee
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality acrylic, offering durability, clarity, and a modern finish.
    - Multi-layer structure creates a 3D rotating display effect.
                      +) Standee belongs to layer 2, acrylic – 3 mm, Main character layer, visible from both front and back.
                      +) Base crafted from 3-layer acrylic, 3 mm thickness, creates a solid base with an integrated rotating mechanism.
                      +) Connector / Rotation System includes 1 bearing (3 mm thickness) for smooth 360° rotation. 
    - Supports up to 4 pairs of disc magnets (3×3 mm) to secure components.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 4 × 4 in ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp, vibrant, and durable colors.
    - Printing by layer:
                      +) Standee (Layer 2): 2-sided printing.
                      +) Base Layer 1: 2-sided printing.
                      +) Other base layers (Layer 2 & 3): no printing (structural support)
    - Ensures correct visibility from both front and back while maintaining structural stability.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative rotating standee, combining both functionality and visual appeal.
    - Features a 360° rotating mechanism with a built-in bearing, allowing smooth and effortless movement.
    - Multi-layer acrylic structure creates a standing 3D display, making the design visible from multiple angles.
    - Easy to assemble with pre-cut slots and components that fit securely together.
    - Compact size makes it suitable for placement on desks, shelves, bedside tables, or display cabinets.
    - Lightweight yet sturdy, ensuring stable placement without tipping over.
    - Ideal for everyday decoration while also serving as a personalized keepsake display.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful and unique gift for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays.
    - Perfect for celebrating family moments, relationships, and special memories.
    - Suitable for gifting to parents, partners, friends, or loved ones.
    - Customizable design makes each piece personal and one-of-a-kind.
    - Combines sentimental value with decorative function, making it both a keepsake and a display item.
    - A thoughtful choice for anyone who appreciates personalized décor and creative gifts.🎁

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic Rotating Standee

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
